changelog:
Initial release of arxiv-skill-extractor:

- Automates the extraction of reusable skill code from arXiv papers.
- Fetches papers, extracts key algorithms, and generates OpenClaw skill templates.
- Supports both programmatic API and command-line usage.
- Enables ongoing integration of research insights into executable skills.
summary: Automates the process of extracting reusable skill code from arXiv papers. Use this skill to turn paper insights into actual OpenClaw skills.
